data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month: an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed or proven best long-run. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: exact intended catch, and any conditions? Fisher23/25, please help recruit.
